# netactuate_firewall_set_rule_order (Resource)

Moves a firewall rule within a firewall set rule order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_firewall_set_rule_order" "example" {
  firewall_set_id = 12345
  move_id         = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_set_id` (Number) Firewall set ID whose rule order is managed.
- `move_id` (Number) Firewall rule ID to move.

### Optional

- `after_id` (Number) Move the rule after this firewall rule ID.
- `before_id` (Number) Move the rule before this firewall rule ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_firewall_set_rule_order.example 12345
```
